note: Shared glossary for every part of Virgil's Eclogues and Georgics. Entries keyed by word form as printed in Greenough (Boston: Ginn & Company, 1881), lowercased, exactly as the reader's word splitter cuts it (enclitic -que/-ne/-ve stay on the word). Lemma — meaning (grammatical info); the lemma may carry macrons for vowel length, the text never does. Seeded on 2026-11-20 with the Aeneid glossary's entries for every form these two works share with it; a run may broaden them for the use here.
